source.name: Kanban
source.description: A Kanban board: work flows Proposed → Ready → Backlog → In Progress → In Test → Completed, with WIP limits on the working columns. Harvested from legacy Mingle's kanban_template.yml.

pages.name: Overview Page
pages.content:
Cumulative Flow

{{ daily-history-chart aggregate: count(*) start-date: {{template:today-2}} end-date: {{template:today+14}} chart-conditions: type = Work chart-title: Cumulative flow y-title: Cards chart-width: 900 chart-height: 400 series: - conditions: status >= "Proposed" color: '#eeefff' label: Proposed - conditions: status >= "Ready" color: '#f28900' label: Ready - conditions: status >= "Backlog" color: '#c9a400' label: Backlog - conditions: status >= "In Progress" color: '#30f200' label: In Progress - conditions: status >= "In Test" color: '#0088cc' label: In Test - conditions: status >= "Completed" color: '#087300' label: Completed }}

The Kanban Board tab shows every Work card by Status, with WIP limits of 2 on In Progress and In Test. New cards start in Proposed, owned by whoever creates them.
